order_averaging_rule: both stages: score the options in the usual and the reversed order (labels by position), average each order's T = 1 probabilities per code (arithmetic mean), then divide log(average) by the stage temperature before renormalising (pipeline/graph_a2.py, scoring.average_orders)

temperature.fitted_on: rulings val run 2ef22673f54540949b6575e892eac169 (arm a2_order_avg), per-stage NLL of the true option; fitted and evaluated on the same 750 val items
